sections.description:
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL COUNCILS ELECTION AUTHORITY
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL COUNCILS
ELECTION AUTHORITY
(COMPOSITION, POWERS AND
FUNCTIONS) RULES, 1996
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary, 30th June, 1996]
No. 8‑372/92(BLCEA), dated
1‑1‑1996.‑‑In exercise of the powers conferred by
section 150 read with section 18 of the Balochistan Local Government Ordinance,
1980 (II of 1980), the Government of Balochistan is pleased to make the
following Rules, namely:‑‑
CHAPTER I
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑ These Rules may be called the Balochistan Local
Councils Election Authority (Composition, Powers and Functions) Rules, 1996.
2. They shall come into
force at once.
CHAPTER II
3. definitions.‑‑In
these rules, unless the context otherwise requires, the following expressions
shall have the meaning, hereby respectively assigned to them:‑‑
(a) Budget' means the Budget of
the Election Authority prepared for a financial year and includes revised or
supplementary budget of that year;
(b) 'Chairman' means the Chairman
of the Election Authority;
(c) 'Election Authority' means
the Balochistan Local Councils Election Authority, appointed under section 18
of the Balochistan Local Government Ordinance, 1980 (II of 1980).
(d) 'Funds' means,‑‑
(i) the Government grants for
conduct of elections and matters related thereto removed from Public Account
with the consent of the higher authority; or
(ii) Nomination fee deposited by
the candidates contesting election to the seats of Muslims or non‑Muslim
or Special Interest Group and Chairman; and
(iii) Appeal fee to be recovered
from appellant for appeals against acceptance or rejection of nomination or
delimitation proposals;
(e) ' Government' means the
Government of Balochistan;
(f) 'Members' means the Members
of the Election Authority;
(g) 'Ordinance' means the Balochistan
Local Government Ordinance, 1980 (II of 1980);
(h) 'Secretary' means Secretary
of Election Authority.
CHAPTER III
4. Composition.‑‑For
the purposes of the elections to the Local Councils and matters connected
therewith, Government shall constitute an Authority consisting of the
following;‑‑
(i) A Chairman who is or has been
Judge of the High Court or a person who is in B‑19 or above is or has
been in service of Federal or Provincial Government or in Local Authority.
(ii) Two members who are or have
been in the service of Provincial Government or the Local Authority in B‑18
and above.
5. Notwithstanding
anything contained in rule 4, Government may re?constitute the Election
Authority after the elections to the Local Councils have been held and the re‑constituted
Election Authority may have such number of members and possess such
qualifications and experience as the Government may consider necessary.
CHAPTER IV
6. Powers and Functions.‑‑The
Election Authority shall subject to the provisions of the Ordinance and Rules,
regulate its own procedure.
7. The Election Authority
may issue such instructions and exercise such powers including the powers to
review an order passed by an officer under the Ordinance or Rules and make such
consequential orders as it may deem necessary for ensuring substantive Justice
that elections and matter connected therewith are conducted honestly, justly
and fairly and that corrupt practices are guarded in accordance with the
provisions of the Ordinance and the rules.
8. The Election Authority
shall have power to issue such directions or orders as may be necessary for the
performance of its functions and duties.
9. All decisions of the
Election Authority shall be expressed in terms of the opinion of the majority
of its members including the Chairman;
Provided that the Election
Authority may exercise its powers and perform its functions notwithstanding a
vacancy in the office of any one of its member or the Chairman or fact that any
of its members or the Chairman is, for any reason unable to attend its
proceedings and decisions taken by the members present shall have the effect of
the decision of the Election Authority
